panZoomToCombat.name: Pan/Zoom to combat
panZoomToCombat.hint: When combat starts, pan/zoom-out the camera to fit observed and hidden combatants for controlled tokens without removing any currently viewed portion of the canvas from view. It will ignore any foundry-hidden or undetected combatants.

visionHack.name: Vision Hack
visionHack.hint:
Tokens with a Stealth effect will dynamically adjust their visibility depending on their hidden or undetected status relevant to the controlled token(s).
Note: this is a hacky vanilla solution and will likely experience weirdness mixing with invisibility, etc.

requireActivity.name: Require 'Avoid Notice' activity
requireActivity.hint: PCs are required to set the 'Avoid Notice' exploration activity active to sneak at combat start. If disabled, PCs instead need to use stealth for initiative.
requireActivity.error: {actor} needs to use {action} if wanting to sneak at combat start.

showEyeballs.name: Enable vision alerts
showEyeballs.hint: Display alerts on canvas tokens which have some visibility to controlled token's stealthy conditions.

collapseTargetList.name: Collapse initiative target lists
collapseTargetList.hint: Initially collapse target lists when adding them to initiative chat cards

hideFromAllies.name: Party stealth affects party members
hideFromAllies.hint: If enabled, party member stealth effect can affect other party members. This checkbox doesn't apply to neutral or opposing tokens.

notifications.noSocketLib: PF2e Stealthy needs socketlib module to be active in order to pan/zoom to combat. Please activate it.
notifications.target1: Point Out action requires a single token to be targeted
notifications.noToDos: No relevant actions for PF2e Stealthy for this context: {controlled} controlled token(s), {targeted} targeted token(s)
notifications.avoidNotice: 'PF2e Stealthy' is a replacement of and extension to 'PF2e Avoid Notice'. Please disable 'PF2e Avoid Notice'
